# shoal_service_account (Resource)

A service account: a non-human principal for CI, integrations and automation. Bind roles to it with `shoal_role_binding` (`subject_kind = "user"`, `subject_id = shoal_service_account.x.id`) and give it keys with `shoal_api_key`. Maps to `/v1/service-accounts/{name}`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "shoal_service_account" "ci" {
  name        = "github-actions"
  description = "Applies Shoal config from CI"
}

resource "shoal_role_binding" "ci" {
  role         = "editor"
  subject_kind = "user" # service accounts bind as users
  subject_id   = shoal_service_account.ci.id
  namespace    = "payments"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Service account name; it acts as `sa:<name>` in audit logs and run history.

### Optional

- `description` (String) What it is used for.
- `display_name` (String) Name shown in the UI. Defaults to `name`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Principal id, used as `subject_id` in role bindings.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import shoal_service_account.ci github-actions
```
